title: Nyra now does the first round of recruiting
summary: Nyra finds, contacts, screens and shortlists candidates for every requirement you switch her on for, and can book the first call. Scheduling and trackers also got easier.

spotlight.title: Auto-screening: Nyra does the first round
spotlight.body: For every requirement you switch her on for, Nyra finds matching candidates in your own resource pool, reaches out, asks the right questions, re-scores them on what they said and hands your recruiters a short list of people who are interested, qualified and ready to talk. It is off until you switch it on for a requirement, and Nyra starts about 30 minutes later. Email is the first channel; WhatsApp will follow.

items.title: Nyra Screened tab, built for decisions
items.body: Candidates who answered, best first, with their answers one click away. Screen in a “Needs review” candidate with one click or decline with a reason, ask Nyra to screen more, give thumbs up or down, preview resumes and export to CSV.

items.title: Nyra books the first discussion
items.body: Turn on auto-schedule and a screened-in candidate gets free slots from the recruiter's working hours. They pick one and it is booked, with calendar invites for both sides that update if the interview moves. No double-booking across jobs.

items.title: Screened-in column on the requirement list
items.body: A new column next to Nyra Matches shows how many candidates are ready for each job.

items.title: Schedule smarter
items.body: Offer candidates up to 7 dates with several slots each, in one invite. If nobody new was invited you no longer see a “Scheduled!” toast, and the selection clears itself once you are done.

items.title: Trackers that just work
items.body: Send trackers for several jobs to the same client contact in one email, with one sheet per job. Job Code comes first, then the fields in the contact's saved order. Last Working Day shows on screen and in Excel. If a resume is missing you are told whose, and candidates are unselected after you send.

items.title: Evaluation questions reset their expected answer
items.body: Reword a default question (Experience, Notice Period, Expected CTC) and its expected answer resets on the spot, so you can set one that fits.

items.title: The Selected tile counts by selection date
items.body: It now takes you straight to the matching Closures.

title: Interview invites that arrive, and figures that fit you
summary: This fortnight is about trust in the basics. WhatsApp interview invites are more dependable and tell you when one didn't land. Everyone now sees the company's own currency and time zone. Offer errors are clearer.

spotlight.title: WhatsApp interview invites that reliably arrive, or tell you why not
spotlight.body: Interview slot links sent over WhatsApp now go out reliably, even when the job has no job description attached. If a message can't be delivered, the Scheduler tells you who missed it and why. The slot stays held, so you can resend it in one step instead of assuming the candidate got it.

items.title: Your company's currency and time zone, for every team member
items.body: Team members without admin access could see amounts in rupees and times in their browser's zone on forms like candidates, clients, requirements and feedback. Everyone who signs in now sees the company's own currency, time zone and country code. Figures and interview times read correctly for the whole team.

items.title: A clear message when an offer CTC isn't valid
items.body: If an offer's CTC is entered in a way that isn't valid, you now get a plain message asking you to correct it. Before, you could hit a generic error with no hint about what went wrong. Fixing the figure and moving on is now quicker.

title: Know who to call first. Every single time.
summary: Nyra, your recruitment assistant, got a lot smarter. Every recommended and tagged candidate now has a match score you can read, Nyra drafts your job descriptions and screening questions, and it starts your day with what needs you.

spotlight.title: A match score on every recommended and tagged candidate
spotlight.body: Nyra checks every candidate against your must-haves and the full job description and gives each one a clear score out of 100. Open any score to see why: what the candidate has against what the role needs, and where each answer came from. Similar skills earn credit too, and one click refreshes a score, or every score on a role.

items.title: Drop in the client's brief, get a polished job description
items.body: Attach the brief your client sent, add a job title and click Generate with Nyra. Your form always wins, Nyra tells you wherever the brief disagrees, and salary never appears in the published text.

items.title: Screening questions, drafted for you
items.body: Nyra reads the job description and suggests the screening questions and must-have skills that matter for the role. Keep the ones you like, add your own, and answers are filled in from the CV when you tag a candidate.

items.title: Your daily briefing from Nyra
items.body: Click the Nyra button on any page to see your day at a glance: fresh strong matches, interviews waiting on your feedback and today's interviews. Need someone new? Just describe who you're looking for in your own words.

items.title: A cleaner, calmer EzRecruit
items.body: Every screen now looks and works the same way. Messages tell you in plain words what happened and what to do next, and your filters live in the page link, so you can bookmark a view or share it with a colleague.

items.title: No more duplicate candidates
items.body: Adding a candidate whose email or phone number is already on file is stopped with a pointer to the existing profile. One person, one record.

items.title: Sort and filter at a glance
items.body: Column controls on every table are always visible now, and filters on Tracker, Reports and Requirements apply the first time you set them.

items.title: Smarter forms
items.body: Required fields are clearly marked, mistakes are flagged right where they happen, and keyboard focus is easy to see everywhere.

items.title: Today's Assignment works again, with Nyra built in
items.body: The dashboard's Today's Assignment grid loads properly, and you can open Nyra matches and candidate responses straight from it.

items.title: Requirement import understands your cities and contacts
items.body: Bulk-importing requirements now matches city names and client contact names to the ones already in your account.

items.title: Goals keep themselves tidy
items.body: Goals can no longer be backdated, and they complete on their own when their target is met.

title: Recommendations, match scores and a much faster résumé reader
summary: Every open role now gets its own list of recommended candidates, scored and ranked. Résumés are read faster, and more file types work than ever.

spotlight.title: Recommended candidates for every open role
spotlight.body: Each job now has a Recommended tab with the best-fit candidates from your database, ranked by match score and kept fresh through the day. Matches, Tagged and Workflow sit side by side on the job page.

items.title: Match score column on Workflow and Closures
items.body: See how well every candidate in your pipeline fits the role, with a score breakdown, and look back at how your hires matched.

items.title: Search candidates straight from a requirement
items.body: A Search candidates button on the requirement view starts a search for that role in one click.

items.title: Preferred employers and notice period on requirements
items.body: Capture the companies your client likes to hire from and the notice period they can accept, right on the requirement form.

items.title: Import Center
items.body: Bring your existing candidate database into EzRecruit yourself, with live progress, a report at the end, and the option to retry or roll back. Ask your account manager to switch it on for your company.

items.title: Bulk import requirements from a spreadsheet
items.body: Upload a CSV of open roles instead of creating them one by one.

items.title: Talent Activity you can trust
items.body: A clear activity drawer with full history in your own time zone, where each candidate is counted once.

items.title: Lead and collaborator at the same time
items.body: A team lead can also act as a collaborator, with a simple switch for which role you're working in.

items.title: Résumés read faster, and more of them
items.body: Most résumés are now read in moments, and RTF files, older Word documents, text boxes and tables all come through cleanly. A damaged PDF no longer stops an upload.

items.title: A new résumé replaces the old one everywhere
items.body: When a candidate sends an updated CV, search and matching use the new one straight away.

items.title: Interview feedback that fits how you work
items.body: On Hold now sits under Screened, No-show is available for interviews in progress, and rescheduled interviews no longer leave an old row behind.

items.title: Clear sign-in messages
items.body: If your account can't sign in, you're told why, and accounts of people who have left the company are blocked automatically.

items.title: Revenue by date of joining
items.body: Quarterly revenue in Analytics now groups placements by the candidate's date of joining.

items.title: Certification search
items.body: Typing a certification name suggests matches again.

title: Publish to EzRefer, cleaner emails and smarter candidate data
summary: Your roles can now reach referrers on EzRefer, candidate emails carry the right details automatically, and bad email addresses are caught before they get in.

spotlight.title: Publish requirements to EzRefer
spotlight.body: Switch on Publish to EzRefer on a requirement and the role appears for referrers. Candidates who apply there flow straight back into EzRecruit.

items.title: Interview emails fill themselves in
items.body: The date, time and interview type come straight from the candidate's scheduled interview.

items.title: A nudge before sending without a résumé
items.body: You're asked to confirm before a candidate email goes out with no résumé attached.

items.title: CVs download with the candidate's name
items.body: No more cryptic file names in your downloads folder.

items.title: Typos in email addresses caught at entry
items.body: Candidate email addresses are checked as you type, with a suggested correction for common typos like gmial.com.

items.title: Salary and notice period picked up from CVs
items.body: Imported CVs now fill in current salary and notice period reliably.

items.title: ROI analytics that read clearly
items.body: Figures round properly, drill-downs stay responsive, and people without access see a clear notice instead of errors.

items.title: WhatsApp interview reminders reach candidates again
items.body: Reminders are delivered, and the Confirm availability link takes candidates straight to their interview.

items.title: Client and recruiter names match everywhere
items.body: Client contacts and recruiter names now show the same way on every screen, including when editing a requirement.

title: Bulk résumé import, AI spend controls and a revamped email module
summary: A big fortnight: whole folders of résumés in one go, full control over AI spend, a redesigned email module, and a much faster interview roster.

spotlight.title: Bulk résumé import
spotlight.body: Upload a batch of résumés at once and EzRecruit reads them all, instead of one file at a time.

items.title: AI spend controls
items.body: Set a monthly AI budget for your company, with allowances per person and per feature, and track usage on a live dashboard.

items.title: A redesigned email module
items.body: A complete refresh of how you write, send and track candidate emails.

items.title: Analytics and ROI reporting
items.body: See the return on your hiring effort with a new analytics module.

items.title: Global Search with live progress
items.body: Watch results arrive as Global Search works. Candidate search now pages through every match, picks up where it left off if your connection drops, and explains problems in plain English.

items.title: One active sign-in per account
items.body: Signing in on a new device signs out the old one, so every account belongs to one person.

items.title: Several collaborators at once
items.body: A supervisor can now work with multiple collaborators together.

items.title: A faster interview roster, with filters that work
items.body: All seven roster filters now apply, columns sort, and the roster stays quick however many interviews you have.

items.title: Smarter candidate ranking
items.body: Every candidate in a ranked list now gets a score, strengths and gaps, with none dropped along the way.

items.title: No more lost work after an update
items.body: Tabs left open during a release keep working, so you don't lose a half-filled form.

items.title: Self-booking and interview messages
items.body: Candidates can book and decline interview slots reliably, and confirmations only go out once a booking succeeds.

items.title: Job description upload and paste
items.body: Pasting or uploading a JD for AI parsing works again.

title: Quicker candidate forms and the groundwork for Global Search
summary: Small touches that make everyday data entry faster, and the first building blocks of Global Search.

items.title: Faster candidate forms
items.body: Designation autocomplete puts exact matches first, documents attach more smoothly, and a new status picker and image zoom save clicks.

items.title: Global Search foundations
items.body: The menu entry and permissions for Global Search arrived, ready for the full feature that followed.
